# Jeevunjee Family Scholarship

> A family-led scholarship for Sri Lankan students and other applicants with the ability and determination to pursue their education, but not the means. Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

- Who can apply: students in secondary, tertiary or vocational programmes; talents in sport, music, arts or science; anyone determined with a real financial gap.
- How to apply: online at https://jeevunjee.com/ (about 15 minutes, one question at a time; photos of documents are fine). Applicants get a reference number straight away.
- How decisions are made: the family's Scholarship Committee reads every application in full and replies to everyone by email.
- Support: paid by term or by milestone, agreed with the student.
